qs.q: A child with a history of recurrent urinary tract infections and vesicoureteric reflux is found to have renal scarring. Which imaging modality is considered the gold standard for diagnosing renal scarring?
qs.e: Radionuclide DMSA scans are identified as the gold standard for detecting renal scarring due to their high sensitivity. Ultrasound has poor sensitivity for scarring, and VCU is primarily used to demonstrate reflux.
